meta.name: ai-sdk-docs-bot-evals
meta.notes: 16 answerable + 4 unanswerable. 'must_include' = identifiers a correct answer should contain (cheap string check). 'stale_signals' = outdated v5/v6 APIs; if the answer RECOMMENDS one of these, it's wrong (mentioning it as deprecated is fine), so grade those with the LLM judge, not string match.

questions.question: In the current AI SDK, how do I pass a system prompt to generateText?
expected_answer: `system` still works as a deprecated fallback
If both are set, `instructions` takes precedence

questions.question: After upgrading, my generateText call fails when my messages array contains a { role: 'system' } message loaded from my database. Why, and how do I fix it?
expected_answer: AI SDK 7 rejects system messages in `prompt`/`messages` by default
Preferred fix: move them to the top-level `instructions` option
For trusted persisted chats, set `allowSystemInMessages: true`
Never enable it for user-editable messages (prompt injection risk)

sources.section: Prompt Messages: System Messages in `prompt` or `messages` Are Rejected by Default

questions.question: What Node.js version does the AI SDK require, and can I still import it with require()?
expected_answer: Node.js 22 or later (tested on 22, 24, 26); 18 and 20 unsupported
Packages are ESM-only; require() is not supported
Add "type": "module" to package.json or use .mjs files

sources.section: Minimum Node.js Version / ESM Only — CommonJS Support Removed

questions.question: How do I stop a multi-step tool-calling loop after 5 steps?
What class do I use to build a tool-using agent, and how many steps does it run by default?
How do I get a typed object that matches a Zod schema from the model?
expected_answer: `generateObject` is deprecated; `experimental_output` was removed in v7

sources.section: Structured Outputs: Remove Deprecated `experimental_output` Option and Result

questions.question: How do I stream a structured object so the UI can render it while it's being generated?
In a multi-step generateText call, does result.usage cover only the last step or all steps? How do I get the other one?
expected_answer: `result.usage` is total usage across all steps

questions.question: After a multi-step tool call, how do I get the full list of assistant and tool messages to save to my database?
expected_answer: `step.response.messages` now only contains that step's messages (no longer accumulated)

sources.section: Step Response Messages Are No Longer Accumulated

questions.question: How do I iterate over every event from streamText, including text deltas and tool calls?
expected_answer: `fullStream` was renamed to `stream` (kept as a deprecated alias)

questions.question: How do I return a UI message stream from my API route so useChat can consume it?
expected_answer: Build it with the top-level `toUIMessageStream({ stream: result.stream, ... })`

sources.section: `streamText` Response Helpers Deprecated — Use Stateless Helpers

questions.question: How do I make a deleteFile tool require user approval before it executes?
expected_answer: Set `toolApproval` on the generateText/streamText call or the agent
e.g. `toolApproval: { deleteFile: 'user-approval' }`, or a function returning 'user-approval' / undefined
`needsApproval` on tool() is deprecated in v7

questions.question: How do I pass an API key into a tool's execute function at call time instead of hardcoding it?
expected_answer: Pass values via `toolsContext`, keyed by tool name
Read it in execute as `{ context }` (typed from the schema)
Shared, non-tool state goes in `runtimeContext`; `experimental_context` was renamed

sources.section: Context: `experimental_context` Became Tool `context`, and Shared Runtime Data Moved to `runtimeContext`

questions.question: How do I enable OpenTelemetry tracing for all AI SDK calls?
expected_answer: Telemetry is then on by default; opt out per call with `isEnabled: false`
The option is now `telemetry` (`experimental_telemetry` is a deprecated alias)

questions.question: How do I read how many input tokens were served from the prompt cache?
How do I create an OpenAI embedding model and embed a single string?
When will AI SDK 8 be released?
expected_answer: The docs don't say; the bot should state that and not guess a date

questions.question: On what date will generateObject be fully removed?
expected_answer: Docs only say it will be removed in a future version; no date given. The bot may mention the Output replacement but must not invent a date or version number

questions.question: What are the AI SDK's built-in default rate limits per API key?
expected_answer: Not in the docs; rate limits come from the model provider. The bot should say it can't find this rather than invent numbers

questions.question: How many weekly npm downloads does the ai package have?
expected_answer: Out of scope for the docs; the bot should decline and not produce a number
